LanguageData.CC_GA_PilgrimFarOut: {PAWN} has set out on the pilgrimage {PAWN_pronoun} vowed to {GOD}, on foot to {PLACE}, and will be away about {DAYS} days.
LanguageData.CC_GA_PilgrimThere: {PAWN} has reached {PLACE} and prayed there to {GOD}, as {PAWN_pronoun} vowed.
LanguageData.CC_GA_PilgrimHome: {PAWN} is home from the pilgrimage to {PLACE} with {THING}, and has a story to tell at supper.
LanguageData.CC_GA_PilgrimHomeNamed: {PAWN} is home from the pilgrimage to {PLACE} with {THING}. {PEOPLE} there call {GOD} {NAME}, and {PAWN} has one of their stories to tell at supper.
LanguageData.CC_GA_PilgrimHomeNothing: {PAWN} is home from the pilgrimage to {PLACE}, and has a story to tell at supper.
LanguageData.CC_GA_PilgrimChronicle: {PAWN} walked to {PLACE} to keep a vow to {GOD}, and came home.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Fisher_Book: {PAWN} gave the first fish of the morning, a {FISH}, back to the water, and it splashed as it went in
LanguageData.CC_GA_Fisher_Journal: Gave the first fish of the morning back to the water, for {GOD}. The fishing went well after.
LanguageData.CC_GA_DebtCoin: A gold coin lies on the doorstep outside {PAWN}'s room this morning.
LanguageData.CC_GA_DebtCoinGate: A gold coin lies by the colony's gate this morning, where {PAWN} passes.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Saw_DebtCoin: {WHO} found a gold coin by {PAWN}'s door at {HOME}, the morning after the colony paid what it owed
LanguageData.CC_GA_TraderStays: {TRADER} of {PEOPLE} has decided to stay half a day longer than planned.
LanguageData.CC_GA_HardBargain: {TRADER} is driving a hard bargain today.
LanguageData.CC_GA_KeeperLooked_Plain: {KEEPER} went out to the place afterwards and saw what was left there.
LanguageData.CC_GA_KeeperLooked_Devout: I, {KEEPER}, went to the place after, and saw with my own eyes what was left there.
LanguageData.CC_GA_KeeperLooked_Learned: The keeper, {KEEPER}, examined the place afterwards and confirmed what was left there.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Keeper_Journal: Wrote up {COUNT} new entries in the colony's book of the gods at the {TABLE}.
LanguageData.CC_GodLore_Cried_Devout: So {TELLER} cried out {HOW}, and I set it down as it was cried: "{WORDS}"
LanguageData.CC_GA_Grave_BeliefUnnamed: {DEAD_nameDef} rests in the keeping of the god {DEAD_pronoun} held.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Grave_Rite: Our dead are given into its keeping when the eulogy is said.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Grave_Letter: Then {PAWN} gave {OTHER_objective} to the god {OTHER_pronoun} held: "{LINE}"
LanguageData.CC_GA_SeasonDay_Kept: The colony kept a day for {GOD} against {SEASON} coming again.
LanguageData.CC_GA_SeasonDay_Passed: The council let the day against {SEASON} pass, and the words were said for {GOD} by one alone.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Midwinter_TreeNoPower: {PAWN} switched on the {TREE} for midwinter, but there is no power to light it.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Midwinter_TreeStood: {PAWN} stood a while at the {TREE} for midwinter.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Midwinter_Table: {PAWN} set out the {FOOD} from the stores beside the {TABLE} for midwinter.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Midwinter_Presents: {PAWN} handed round the midwinter presents, one each to {COUNT} of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Midwinter_PresentsJournal: Handed round the midwinter presents, one each to {COUNT} of us.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Midwinter_Snow: {PAWN} made a {WHAT} in the snow for midwinter.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Midwinter_Impact: Midwinter with the festive things the colony has: the tree switched on at dusk, the gingerbread and warm drinks set out at supper, the presents handed round after it, a snow sculpture by day.
LanguageData.CC_GA_Midwinter_ImpactBrief: the festive tree, the table and the presents
